item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "c3380d1db8169ba8bec1502b3fe3c36534f1387403319cd10054993e97dbb277",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "A type indexed by real constants K and rho, bundling rho ≠ 0, two real-valued functions p and u of two real variables, and the everywhere differential condition specified by D008, as exhibited by D007 and the projections D002–D003.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantification over system supplies the functions and their differential hypotheses; system is not an arbitrary pair of functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Projects the second component of system, the function p : R → R → R called pressure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies p in the function whose transport equation is asserted.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Projects the third component of system, the function u : R → R → R called velocity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies u in the function whose transport equation is asserted.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For real-valued w, this is exactly LocalDef006 w c x t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expands the second conclusion into existence of partial derivatives satisfying w_t + c w_x = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Maps p, u, rho and c to the function w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (rho c)u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the dependent variable in the conclusion, with a plus sign and coefficient rho c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For q : R → R → E in a real normed vector space E, asserts existence of qt and qx in E such that the time slice has derivative qt at t, the spatial slice has derivative qx at x, and qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to E = R, requires actual partial derivatives of w at each point and their equation with speed c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "Constructs a system at K,rho from rho ≠ 0, functions p,u : R → R → R, and a proof that D008 holds for every real x,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exhibits the nonzero-density and global differential requirements bundled in the system parameter.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "At x,t there exist real pt,px,ut,ux giving respectively the time and spatial derivatives of p and u, with pt + K ux = 0 and ut + rho⁻¹ px = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides both coupled equations and existence of all four first partial derivatives at every point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication is continuous on every normed additive commutative group equipped with a normed real vector-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance needed for the derivative predicate in D006; adds no hypothesis about q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication of real numbers acting on real numbers is continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies derivative infrastructure for real-valued p and u, rather than an additional regularity assumption on them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction of two propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both positive c and the everywhere transport assertion, and all conjuncts inside the differential predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects real division in K/rho.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts and applies the supplied heterogeneous division operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here forms the real quotient K/rho.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict comparison relation from an LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity of K, rho and c using real order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal through its specified instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed literal 0 as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All parameters, coordinates, function values and derivative witnesses in the specialized target are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative structure with reciprocal and division, satisfying a/b = a b⁻¹.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives K/rho its usual real arithmetic interpretation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes each positivity assertion an ordinary strict real inequality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero element of the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the zero used in inequalities and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Takes the nonnegative square root after replacing a negative real input by zero, then returns the result as a real number.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines c = sqrt(K/rho); under the positive-parameter hypotheses this is the positive square root.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's zero element to interpret the numeral 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the target's numeral zeros with real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Promotes ordinary division on one type to heterogeneous division on that same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the target's division notation to real division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the supplied addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the sums in w and in the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the supplied multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms rho c u, K ux and rho⁻¹ px as ordinary real products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Views a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by field multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specializes D006 to the usual real vector space R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the real sums in the constructed function and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the coefficients and products in the differential assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed additive structure for real-valued derivative witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm and compatible metric, including multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the standard scalar and normed-field structures for differentiation and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Promotes an addition operation to heterogeneous addition on the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition notation to the relevant real or vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes a multiplication operation to heterogeneous multiplication on the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition, subtraction and negation structure of an additive commutative group as a subtraction commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive operations used by the normed-vector-space infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the addition used in the abstract equation qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the identity requirement while retaining the associative commutative addition of an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the same addition through the typeclass hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition and its commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the same addition to the operation used in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero and the additive identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the zero and addition infrastructure for the differential equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the right-hand zero of the abstract vector equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations addition and zero from an additive identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the zero used in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field inherits a nontrivial norm and the same normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed scalar field required by HasDerivAt over R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication distributing over addition and preserving zero from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the vector-space scalar action to the operation in the transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its zero-preservation property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate projection to the scalar action in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets norm separation while retaining the extended seminormed additive commutative monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited additive infrastructure without changing the target's real domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for D006 through inherited structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the extended seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the same additive and norm structures along an instance path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited addition and zero in the abstract differential predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality between two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the differential expressions to equal zero exactly.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a proposition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies the partial derivative values inside each pointwise differential condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the supplied scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms speed • qx, which specializes to the real product c qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the indicated derivative at the indicated point, using the neighborhood filter at that point and the fixed base point; for real-valued real functions this is the ordinary two-sided derivative.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires existence of genuine derivatives of the coordinate slices, rather than merely assigning values through a total derivative operator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplication inherited from the real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality a ≠ b means the negation of a = b.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the constructor's density restriction rho ≠ 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure whose negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same additive zero along an inherited group-structure path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Describes the generic codomain structure of D006; the target uses the standard instance on R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the codomain additive group required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an extended-normed additive commutative monoid using its existing norm and addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited addition and zero instances without introducing infinite-valued target functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group and induced pseudometric while forgetting the separation requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the seminormed structure required by NormedSpace and topology projections.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with a compatible norm satisfying the scalar norm bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the generic real vector-space structure in D006, specialized to R over itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar multiplication for the transport equation and derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure compatible with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the norm-induced metric structure toward the topology used for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has norms attaining values between any two strictly ordered nonnegative real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides, in particular, the nontrivial norm required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The inferred multiplicative monoid structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports ordinary real multiplication in the division structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The inferred semiring structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the standard real module and multiplicative action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a zero-preserving scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the scalar multiplication appearing in D006.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric associated with a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the codomain topology used in differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation and the law that negation fixes zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the additive zero through an instance path used by the differential predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining the subtraction monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the same underlying additive operations in the instance hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips the existing subtraction and negation structure with its law that negation fixes zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited zero and negation infrastructure; imposes no extra condition on p or u.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes derivative limits use the topology inherited from the norm or real metric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Promotes scalar multiplication to heterogeneous scalar multiplication with unchanged codomain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves speed • qx to the scalar action supplied by the normed space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains associative commutative addition and zero from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides additive monoid structure for scalar actions and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity while retaining an additive group's operations and laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited additive operations required by differentiation infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid with subtraction and negation underlying an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual additive operations through the instance hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar action is jointly continuous as a function of scalar and vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is structural support for HasDerivAt, supplied by D009 or D010 rather than assumed of the solution functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring structure used in scalar-action construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's commutative semiring, reciprocal and division structure as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real arithmetic while providing an instance path to scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the reciprocal operation from an inverse instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms rho⁻¹ in the second bundled differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication and its identity from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative monoid supporting the scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the same norm and additive structure toward the real seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed additive commutative group of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive and pseudometric structures needed for the real normed-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the underlying normed field while forgetting the explicit nontrivial-norm property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the scalar field structures used by HasDerivAt compatible with the ordinary real normed field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative ring and compatible pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited seminormed structures on R without altering derivative semantics.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real field arithmetic underlying the derivative and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The inferred additive commutative group of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real addition, subtraction and negation for the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "The real reciprocal operation, with the field's totalized value zero at zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets rho⁻¹ as the usual nonzero reciprocal because rho > 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring with its usual norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible normed and additive structures for real scalar multiplication and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric given by distance(x,y) = |x − y|, with its compatible uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the limits in derivatives use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring, reciprocal and division operations and laws from a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Passes the same real operations toward the semiring instance used for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the multiplicative identity requirement while preserving the ring's addition, multiplication, norm and pseudometric.",
